versions.changelog:
Initial release of HTTP Client skill.

- Supports GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, and PATCH HTTP methods
- Allows custom headers, body content (JSON/Form/Text), and timeout settings
- Implements response validation, error handling, and latency measurement
- Features automatic retry mechanism and request history logging
- Supports Bearer, Basic, and API Key authentication
- Provides built-in methods for REST and GraphQL API calls
